content.user_title: Debug Cloudflare Workers with Local Explorer
content.value_statement: Cloudflare Workers debugging requires matching local tools, binding configuration, and observability data. This skill guides agents through existing project commands, Local Explorer discovery, and scoped production diagnostics.
actual_capabilities: Guide local startup using the existing cf dev, Wrangler, or Cloudflare Vite project command.
Discover Local Explorer API operations from the development server OpenAPI specification.
Guide inspection and seeding of local KV, R2, D1, SQLite-backed Durable Objects, and Workflows data.
Guide local request debugging through traces and logs, including binding operations.
Route deployed Worker diagnostics to logs, traces, metrics, and available Cloudflare MCP observability operations.
Draft sanitized skill feedback and require approval of the exact issue text before public submission.
limitations: This skill provides instructions, not a bundled development server or standalone debugging implementation.
Local Explorer operations depend on the installed Wrangler or Cloudflare Vite plugin version.
Bindings configured as remote can access deployed resources even during local development.
Production API diagnostics require suitable account access and a connected Cloudflare MCP server when using the MCP workflow.

use_cases.title: Inspect local request failures
use_cases.description: Start the existing development command and inspect Local Explorer traces to identify failing requests and binding operations.

use_cases.title: Prepare local binding test data
use_cases.description: Discover supported data operations and distinguish simulated bindings from remote resources before seeding a test environment.

use_cases.title: Investigate deployed Worker incidents
use_cases.description: Choose logs, traces, or metrics and scope available observability queries to the affected Worker and incident window.

prompt_templates.title: Start local development
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this Cloudflare Workers project and identify its existing development command. Start it using the project configuration and report the development server origin.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a failing request
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate the failing local request at [path]. Discover the Local Explorer API schema, then inspect relevant traces and logs before proposing changes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare binding test data
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare sample data for [binding]. Identify remote bindings first, discover supported Local Explorer operations, and propose the data changes. Do not write until I approve.

prompt_templates.title: Scope a production investigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate [symptom] for [Worker] in [account] during [time window]. Select relevant observability data and discover available MCP operations. Keep queries scoped and report evidence.

output_examples.input: What should I inspect before adding logging to a failing local request?
output: Inspect Local Explorer traces and logs for the failing invocation.
Review binding operations recorded with the request.
Use the development server API schema to discover supported queries.

output_examples.input: Can I seed every binding while the Worker is running locally?
output: Check each binding configuration before writing data.
A remote binding accesses a deployed resource even when the Worker runs locally.
Separate simulated test data changes from any proposed remote changes.

output_examples.input: The skill recommended an unsupported option. Help me report it.
output: Draft feedback describing the affected skill section, expected behavior, actual behavior, and impact.
Remove secrets, resource identifiers, private code, logs, and internal addresses.
Show the exact issue title and body for approval before posting publicly.

best_practices: Use existing project commands and consult installed help, current documentation, and the Local Explorer schema before choosing flags or endpoints.
Inspect local traces before adding logging, and identify remote bindings before making data changes.
Scope production diagnostics to the target account, Worker, and time window; review sanitized feedback before public submission.
anti_patterns: Guessing API endpoints or command flags without checking the installed tools and schema.
Assuming every binding is simulated because the Worker runs locally.
Posting feedback containing private data or publishing an issue without approval of its exact text.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Wrangler project?
faq.answer: No. It follows the existing project tooling, including cf dev, Wrangler, or the Cloudflare Vite plugin.

faq.question: Which bindings does Local Explorer cover?
faq.answer: The skill references local KV, R2, D1, SQLite-backed Durable Objects, and Workflows. Local Explorer can also trigger Cron handlers.

faq.question: How does the agent discover Local Explorer operations?
faq.answer: It reads the OpenAPI specification from the Local Explorer API on the development server origin and selects operations needed for the task.

faq.question: Can local development affect deployed data?
faq.answer: Yes. Bindings marked remote access real deployed resources, so inspect their configuration before seeding or writing data.

faq.question: Can this skill help debug deployed Workers?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes debugging to Workers observability and uses scoped API operations when a Cloudflare MCP connection is available.

faq.question: Does feedback get posted automatically?
faq.answer: No. The workflow requires permission, removal of sensitive details, and approval of the exact issue title and body before public submission.
